Boxplot for baseline level of TRP metabolites
```{r}
colnames(jm_abu_inputdata_26$long_data)
plot_hiv_df <- jm_abu_inputdata_26$long_data %>% dplyr::filter(day == 0) %>% dplyr::select(-c("Subject_id", "day", "study"))
plot_df <- jm_abu_inputdata_27$long_LTA4Hrm %>% dplyr::filter(day == 0) %>% dplyr::select(-c("Subject_id", "day", "study"))
```

```{r}
plot_long_df <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -arm,          # pivot all columns except arm
    names_to = "Metabolite",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

head(plot_long_df)

plot_hiv_long_df <- plot_hiv_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -arm,
    names_to = "Metabolite",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

plot_all <- bind_rows(
  plot_long_df,
  plot_hiv_long_df
)

name_map <- c(
  "Tryptophan" = "Tryptophan",
  "Nicotinamide" = "Nicotinamide",
  "5-HIAA" = "5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid",
  "5-HydroxyTryptamine" = "5-Hydroxytryptamine",
  "Kynurenine" = "Kynurenine",
  "AntranilicAcid" = "Anthranilic acid",
  "5-HydroxyTryptophol" = "5-hydroxytryptophol",
  "Alanine" = "Alanine",
  "3-IndoleaceticAcid" = "Indole-3-acetic acid",
  "KynurenicAcid" = "Kynurenic acid"
)

plot_long_df$Metabolite <- name_map[plot_long_df$Metabolite]

met_order <- c("Tryptophan", "Kynurenine", "Kynurenic acid", "Anthranilic acid", "Nicotinamide","Alanine", 
               "5-Hydroxytryptamine", "5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid", "5-hydroxytryptophol", "Indole-3-acetic acid")
plot_long_df$Metabolite <- factor(plot_long_df$Metabolite,levels = met_order)
stat_df <- plot_long_df %>%
  group_by(Metabolite) %>%
  wilcox_test(Value ~ arm) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  mutate(p_text = format(p.adj, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2))
plot_list <- list()
for (met in met_order) {
  sub_df <- plot_long_df %>%
    filter(Metabolite == met)
  sub_stat <- stat_df %>%
    filter(Metabolite == met)
  ymax <- max(sub_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ymin <- min(sub_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  
  bar_y  <- ymax + 0.12 * yrange
  text_y <- ymax + 0.18 * yrange
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = arm, y = Value, color = arm)) +
    # geom_boxplot(
    #   width = 0.65,
    #   fill = NA,
    #   linewidth = 1.2,
    #   outlier.shape = NA) +  
    # geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) + 
    geom_beeswarm(method = "center", size = 2, cex = 1, alpha = 0.6) + 
    stat_summary(fun.data = function(x) {
      data.frame(
        y = median(x),
        ymin = quantile(x, 0.25),
        ymax = quantile(x, 0.75)
      )
    },geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
    stat_summary(
      fun = median,
      geom = "point",
      shape = 95,
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    annotate("segment",x = 1,xend = 2, y = bar_y, yend = bar_y, linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("segment",x = 1,xend = 1, y = bar_y - 0.03 * yrange, yend = bar_y,linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2,y = bar_y - 0.03 * yrange, yend = bar_y, linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = text_y, label = sub_stat$p_text, size = 4) +
    expand_limits(y = text_y + 0.05 * yrange) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Placebo" = "#a1caf1","Dexamethasone" = "#be0032")) +
    labs(title = met,x = NULL, y = "Log2(Peak intensity)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10,r = 10,b = 30,l = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      panel.background=element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = 'white'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", colour="black", size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="plain", colour="black", size=14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="plain", colour="black", size=12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="plain", colour="black", size=12),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(face="plain", colour = "black", size = 12),
        # legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text=element_text(face = "bold", size=12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  plot_list[[met]] <- p
}
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 5)
combined_plot
ggsave(
  filename = "./plots/Metabolite_HIV_comparison.tiff",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
